purpose: Apply the SGFN-supervised 69-parameter nonlinear rescorer to Open3DSG without refitting, source-specific normalization, or hyperparameter changes.

training.labels: exact predicate-label correctness for SGFN ordered object pairs
training.normalization: SGFN internal-dev means and standard deviations only

model.architecture: two-hidden-unit ReLU MLP with predicate-linear skip
model.parameter_match: equals the 22+23+24=69 trainable coefficients in the three strict family compatibility calibrators

interpretation_gate: Transfer requires no target-source labels or statistics and must be reported at every K; no winner-only promotion is allowed.
claim_boundary: This is a retrospective cross-source diagnostic on the same 3DSSG target, not dataset generalization or prospective confirmation.
